svg.title: Design sheet · Arm-and-shoulder piece (Project 13)
svg.text: Front view of the right shoulder and arm. Trace the flower, the vines and the bracelet, then try your own colors.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Order: lead lines, shoulder flower, vines and leaves, bracelet and buds, outlines, highlights and dots.
